info.syllabusName: Công nghệ trong giảng dạy (Information and Communication Technology (ICT) in Language Teaching)
info.syllabusEnglish: Information and Communication Technology (ICT) in Language Teaching
info.description:
- The course provides learners with the basics and the use of technology in teaching, including text editing software, email, blogs, online sites, and online courses;

- The program consists of 12 lessons.
info.decisionNo: Ban hành theo QĐ CTĐT TDTU

clos.loDetails: Know and understand how to use means of technology in teaching, including preparing presentations, supporting teaching and organizing online learning activities.
Analyze and identify the right means of technology for appropriate application for teaching.

Create learning materials by using text editors, using the online site to search for information, using online tools such as email, chat, blogs to interact with students, or creating online courses which aims to support learning activities, assessing students, designing exercises and assessing the IT applications of learners.
Understand and recognize the importance of applying technology in teaching in the modern society context.
